To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the proposed method is able to achieve a high accuracy in sepsis prediction for patients in the ICU.

1) a method taking into account the amount of the patients' length of stay in ICU, 2) a solution including feature selection, weighting based training on an imbalanced dataset, 3) a model that has few or more predictors, depending on the patients' length in ICU, are all important for successful sepsis detection.

a) a two stage approach is needed for successful prediction of sepsis in ICU patients; b) the length of stay is a key factor for the success of sepsis prediction; c) the performance of the models is strongly dependent on the metrics used for the evaluation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a machine learning model that can predict sepsis in ICU patients.
the development of a method for sepsis prediction in patients in the intensive care units based on the amount of time they spend in the ICU.
the early prediction of sepsis and the development of an algorithm that can be used for early sepsis detection in the ICU.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed method can improve sepsis prediction accuracy by 5-6% in comparison with other models.
the presented research is a good example of how to deal with unbalanced data, and how to achieve a good prediction of the sepsis in patients in the ICU.
a combination of two different models, each with a different set of input variables, depending on the length of time spent in the Intensive Unit Care Unit, is the most accurate solution.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed method can be used as a baseline model in the development of new sepsis detection algorithms.
a two stage monitoring system for sepsis prediction is proposed.
the length of stay of the patient in the Intensive care unit (ICUs) is a significant factor for predicting the sepsis in patients.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the length of stay of the patients in ICU is a key factor for sepsis detection.
the proposed method is able to predict sepsis with a higher accuracy than the baseline model, while using less number of predictors.
the time spent in the ICU should be considered in the development of sepsis detection algorithms.
